title: Security and supply-chain posture snapshot
original_request: Execute the matching task in docs/agent-execution/13_TASK_GRAPH.md; preserve scope and report evidence.
goal: Inspect permissions, CI workflows, dependency manifests, lockfiles, secret-scanning configuration, release process and network exposure.
Report secret exposure indicators without printing values.
non_goals: Do not rotate, delete, or edit credentials/settings.
Do not print secret values or credential fragments.
constraints: Read-only discovery. Do not mutate repository source or GitHub settings.
Do not expose or reuse credentials previously disclosed in chat.
Record source, timestamp, commit, and method for every material claim.

assumptions.text: polymath-os is the intended target repository

acceptance_criteria.statement: Security findings include path/line/evidence and severity rationale
Potential secrets are redacted and never copied into report
Workflow permissions and mutable dependencies are inventoried
acceptance_criteria.verification: Review workflow files and lock state.
